interface.windows.col.name: Element
interface.windows.copied: {file} comes from the game and has changes: saving copies it whole into the mod ({count} elements).
interface.windows.from_game: {file} comes from the game ({count} elements): editing it puts a full copy in the mod with the same name.
interface.windows.hide_tip: Moves the element off the screen without deleting it: the game looks up many elements by name.

interface.windows.no_element: Pick an element in the tree or on the canvas to see and edit its properties.

interface.windows.zoom_tip: Frames the chosen window; unchecked, the whole screen at the chosen resolution is shown.
